conditions: READ observation only; current real read rights and same-authority original/raw receipt/index/session joins remain required before disclosure.

Computed metadata has no payload retrieval, units revalidation or chart data; golden artifact digests do not establish possession/replication/publication.

Future positive publication/projection/result completion requires a separate actual A2/A4/A7 codec/version and protected two-domain closure; this proposal cannot silently represent or erase such known positive facts.
